# Stray Angel Films

> > Professional photography and film production services based in Los Angeles, California, specializing in commercial, product, food, and fashion photography with regulatory compliance expertise.

Stray Angel Films is a Los Angeles-based production company offering comprehensive studio services including professional photography for commercial clients. The company maintains compliance with regulatory frameworks including HIPAA, FISMA, and GLBA for sensitive client work.
